planets.name: HD 50554 d
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 50554 with a 28.1-day year, found in 2026.

text.card: HD 50554 d was found in 2026 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around HD 50554. Its orbit and size follow Liu et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
